theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_mollified_tendstoUniformlyOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R s c Λ : ℝ) (φ : Euclid n → ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < s → s < R → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → tsupport φ ⊆ ball 0 s → (∀ k, IntegrableOn (u k) (ball 0 (2 * R))) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), |u k y| ≤ Λ) → (∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ ball 0 (2 * R) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u k y * b y) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ y, b y))) → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k x => ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)) (fun _ => c * ∫ y, φ y) atTop (closedBall 0 R)
